name: case1_bakeoff_mutual_qubit_dialup_collapse
description: Collapse-code rerun of the Burgers MUTUAL bakeoff (A=0.3, nu=0.03) on q8020-cfd-ch-lbm via AWS Batch, 2026-09-03. Same fair stock-vs-stock CH-vs-QLBM comparison as case1_bakeoff_mutual_qubit_dialup, but CH runs with collapse ON (default): the per-step QFT/diagonal/QFT^-1 layers within each read-out-free segment fold to a single exact heat propagator. This is a pure circuit-depth optimization (mathematically exact for the diagonal heat operator), so CH accuracy matches June to shot noise, but the circuit-cost metrics (qubits/depth/2q gates) drop sharply: CH qubits 10/14/17 -> 7/10/13, deepest depth 3046/16602/84156 -> 808/4438/21944, CX/circuit 1006/6628/40272 -> 247/1606/9416. QLBM is untouched by collapse (flat 9 qubits, ~432.6k depth). This dataset is the collapse counterpart of fig1; regenerate fig1_collapse.png from it.
